The Tailorly
On your device · nothing uploaded

Resume + job post → tailored, live

Tailor your resume to any job in seconds.

Drop in your resume and the job description. Your match score, missing keywords and sharper bullet points appear right beside them, and update as you type.

Drop your resume here

0 wordsPaste the whole post

Your tailored results appear here.

  1. Paste or drop your resume on the left.
  2. Paste the job description below it.
  3. See your score, gaps and rewrites instantly. Nothing to submit.
0%

Match

Keywords that countReads the job post like a recruiter’s screening software: must-haves weigh more than nice-to-haves, and repeated or title-level terms weigh most.
Honest by designIt never adds experience for you. Missing keywords are only added to your skills line after you tick “I have this”.
Private by defaultEverything runs in your browser. Your resume is not uploaded, saved or tracked. The optional AI boost uses your own key.

The Tailorly checks wording, keywords and structure. It cannot judge how good your experience is, and no tool can promise an interview or beat every applicant tracking system. Treat every suggestion as a draft, and keep every line true.

Privacy

Your resume and the job description are read and analysed inside your browser. They are not uploaded to or stored by this site. The page sets no cookies, runs no ads and has no visitor tracking, and nothing you type is saved, so copy or download your result before you close the tab. The optional AI boost is off until you add your own API key. If you turn it on and press an AI button, the bullet points and job text are sent from your browser to Anthropic under your key and Anthropic’s terms, not to this site. The server that hosts the page may keep ordinary technical logs, such as the time of a request and an IP address.

Terms of use

Suggestions are produced automatically and can be wrong or incomplete. You are responsible for every statement in the resume you send, including accuracy, and you should never claim skills, jobs or results you do not have. The Tailorly gives writing and keyword suggestions only. It is not career, recruiting or legal advice, and it does not promise an interview, a job or a pass through any applicant tracking system. The service is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.

Credits

Matching, scoring and rewriting use plain text analysis written for this site. PDF files are read with PDF.js (Apache 2.0) and Word files and downloads are handled with fflate (MIT). Typefaces are Fraunces, Instrument Sans and JetBrains Mono (SIL Open Font License). The Tailorly is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any employer, job board or recruiting software company.

AI boost (optional)

The Tailorly works fully on your device. If you also want an AI model to rewrite your bullets for the job, add your own Anthropic API key. When you press an AI button, your resume bullets and the job post are sent to Anthropic from your browser. Nothing goes to this site.

Use a key with a spending limit. Anyone with access to this browser profile could use a remembered key.
